name: fractal-rave-webapps
description: FractalRave web apps: Aurora, FOraveR, Jeffer, Generative Singularity

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd apps/aurora && npm install && cd ../foRAVEr && npm install && cd ../jeffer && npm install && cd ../singularity && npm install && cd ../../packages/shared && npm install
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix apps/aurora && npm run build --prefix apps/foRAVEr && npm run build --prefix apps/jeffer && npm run build --prefix apps/singularity && npm run build --prefix packages/shared
scripts.typecheck:all: npm run typecheck --prefix apps/aurora && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/foRAVEr && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/jeffer && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/singularity && npm run typecheck --prefix packages/shared
scripts.test:all: npm test --prefix apps/aurora && npm test --prefix apps/foRAVEr && npm test --prefix apps/jeffer && npm test --prefix apps/singularity
scripts.smoke:all: npm run smoke --prefix apps/aurora && npm run smoke --prefix apps/foRAVEr && npm run smoke --prefix apps/jeffer && npm run smoke --prefix apps/singularity
scripts.verify:all: npm run typecheck:all && npm run test:all && npm run build:all
